## Description
For storing 20 kg / 100 L (200 bar) methane. &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;Empty tank mass: 40 kg.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;Tank Type 4 (plastic liner + carbon fiber).&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;Tank-to-Gas Mass Ratio is 2:1.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;At 15 kW with ~40% system efficiency (reformer + stack), &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;methane consumption is roughly 0.7–0.8 kg/hour at full load.
